name: hovercard2
title: Profile Hover Card
blurb: Profile card with image zoom and name/role slide-up on hover.
description: A vertical card with image and profile info. Image zooms out and gains color on hover while text overlay slides up to reveal full description.
use_when: Team member profiles, contributor showcases, or testimonial cards where photo zoom adds polish.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical flows where image color/zoom could distract from text content.
a11y: Profile info is text-based; image has alt. Hover state is visual only; text remains readable.
